recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current core source follow-up is needed; any residual concern about old STU3 generated schematron output is a historic publication/backport question rather than a current-build fix.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 FHIR-core-CareTeam change request to update the CareTeam.participant ctm-1 XPath so relative Practitioner/... references satisfy the invariant.
initial_application: Commit bd3f8a7ba5aba2347a6542d772cdc96897766a9c explicitly included #13293 Update CareTeam invariant and changed the CareTeam XPath from a leading-slash contains-only Practitioner test to the starts-with plus contains form requested by the issue. Commit 88a1f3d6bd60f7618ae140179b008ac5686e8a08 later removed checked-in ElementDefinition XPath values, including the already-fixed ctm-1 XPath.
additional_context: FHIR-21219 later reported the same STU3 schematron false-positive and recorded that the resource was already fixed. FHIR-42928 subsequently broadened CareTeam.participant.onBehalfOf and removed ctm-1, leaving the current source with ctm-1 only in an XML comment and no active XPath/string-reference test.
reconciliation: No source change was made. CareTeam remains an active resource, but the current build source has no active restrictive XPath and the later approved removal of ctm-1 should not be undone.
